summary: First full E2E run of RainCheck. Backend: 23/24 pytest pass (markets, auth, business CRUD + user scoping, AI profile draft, paper positions, dashboard stats, kalshi creds validation, mode=kalshi without creds -> 400). Frontend: landing + live ticker, protected-route redirects, onboarding (sample chip -> AI draft -> edit -> save -> /business/:id -> AI report with 2 risk cards + 2 hedge cards), hedge sheet (title, settlement rules, YES/NO toggle, loss input, coverage slider, calc cost=contracts*price, payout=contracts), paper trade toast + appears on business page and dashboard, stats update ($100->$200), paper delete, markets (city select, rain tab filter, search, empty state, row opens sheet), settings (Demo preselected, invalid PEM error toast, Place-on-Kalshi hidden + connect link shown) all PASS. Real Kalshi order placement untested (no keys); code review found a likely blocking issue there.

critical.issue: Kalshi Create Order V2 (/portfolio/events/orders) lists `self_trade_prevention_type` (taker_at_cross|maker) as REQUIRED (https://docs.kalshi.com/api-reference/orders/create-order-v2). The request body in kalshi.py buy() leaves it out, so real orders will probably be rejected with a 400. Add "self_trade_prevention_type": "taker_at_cross".

minor.issue: An unknown or invalid ticker returns 500. kalshi.market_detail raises httpx.HTTPStatusError and nothing catches it. Wrap it like GET /markets/{ticker} does and return 404.
Only reads the cookie, so a Bearer token session is not deleted (logout returns 200 but the token still works).
Positions linked to the business are left behind with a dangling business_id.

ui_bugs.issue: Chip labels use s.split(',')[0]. Chip 0 shows a short label, but chips 1 and 2 show almost the whole sentence because their first comma comes late, so the chips look inconsistent.

integration_issues.flow: Hedge card vs hedge sheet price
integration_issues.issue: The hedge card shows the price stored with the report (e.g. 20¢, cost $64.00), while the sheet shows the live price (19¢, $60.80). This is expected after prices move, but it may confuse users. Consider labelling the card price 'as of report time'.

action_items: Add self_trade_prevention_type='taker_at_cross' to the Kalshi V2 order body in kalshi.py buy() (required field)
Catch httpx.HTTPStatusError in POST /api/positions market lookup -> 404
Logout: also delete the session when the token comes from the Authorization Bearer header
Optional: cascade or handle positions when a business is deleted; validate loss_if_event >= 0
critical_code_review_comments: kalshi.py buy(): V2 body is missing required self_trade_prevention_type. NO side is bought via ask at 1-no_ask, which matches the docs.
advisor.py uses model claude-sonnet-5-5. It responded correctly through the Emergent key during testing.
Kalshi credentials are encrypted with Fernet and private_key_enc is excluded from status responses. Good.
The AI report endpoint has no rate limit or concurrency guard. Repeated 'Refresh with live prices' clicks trigger expensive LLM calls (the button is disabled only while busy).
test_credentials: test_session_raincheck (test-user-1). Seeded second user test-user-2 with session test_session_raincheck_2 for scoping tests.
seed_data_creation: Seeded test-user-2 and session test_session_raincheck_2 in test_database. A UI-created business e72744f85d8d was deleted afterwards; one paper position created via UI may remain for test-user-1 with business_id e72744f85d8d (the other was deleted in the dashboard test).
